value.answer: Drooling, chewing on things, and fussiness are classic, usually harmless teething signs at this age, sometimes with gum swelling or disrupted sleep. Fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or a runny nose aren't caused by teething itself. Cold teething rings, gum massage, and something safe to chew usually help.
value.triage: Call 811 (Health811) if fussiness seems more than mild, feeding drops off, or you're unsure. Go to the ER (or call 911) for real fever (100.4F/38C+), vomiting, diarrhea, rash, lethargy, or refusal to drink - those point to something other than teething.
